proposals.headline: The 'generated by' internal-narration exemption (validation/registry.py:324-326, _NOT_DOCUMENT_GENERATED_BY) enumerates a fixed noun list (library/package/module/crate/tool/project) that omits a repository's own real subsystem name, so a true technical description is misclassified as self-referential document narration.
proposals.measured: BC-07 failure detail: "internal narration 'generated by'", section_id api_reference. content_units.json's own text, verbatim: 'The aspose_html.tokenizer.EndTagToken class represents an end tag token generated by the tokenizer.' and '...constructs the DOM tree from tokens generated by the tokenizer.' Neither phrase is verbatim in any SUPPORTED inherited_unit fact or public_symbol docstring - the real docstrings (src/aspose_html/tokenizer/_tokens.py:87, src/aspose_html/tree/_builder.py:106-110, read directly from the pinned clone) say 'An end tag token, e.g. .' and '...consumes tokens from a Tokenizer and builds a Document tree...' respectively, neither containing the bigram 'generated by'. 'tokenizer' is not itself a bare SUPPORTED public_symbol name (the real symbol is capitalised 'Tokenizer', a different string). The sentence is authoring's own true paraphrase of the product's real behavior, not narration about the document's own authorship.
proposals.owner_choice: widen the exemption to admit a noun that is itself a real component of the repository's own surface (matching symbol_names the way the narration check's own 'validator' entry already does), rather than adding subsystem nouns to a hand-maintained list one repository at a time. Lane E does not propose admitting any 'generated by the <noun>' unconditionally.
proposals.lane_e_position: no standing to choose; evidence recorded for the owner

proposals.headline: The canonical-abbreviation scanner (_LOWER_WORD) has no hyphen-continuation guard, unlike the sibling _COMMAND check already hardened for exactly this shape (python-pptx, arrival item 26), so 'html' inside the repository's own declared distribution name aspose-html-foss is misflagged as a bare, uncapitalised abbreviation.
sites: src/repository_presenter/components/readme/validation/registry.py:275-284 (_COMMAND, the sibling check already carrying a hyphen guard)
proposals.measured: BC-07 failure detail: "abbreviation 'html' is not in its canonical form HTML", section_id documentation_resources. Every occurrence (content_units.json units 329,331,334-337) sits inside a link description naming the repository's own package:name fact value, e.g. '...API reference for all 243 public types in aspose-html-foss.' _LOWER_WORD = re.compile(r"(?<![.\w])[a-z]{3,}\b") excludes a match preceded by a dot or word character but not by a hyphen, so 'html' inside 'aspose-html-foss' (preceded by '-') matches and is then found in canonical_abbreviations()'s fixed html->HTML table.
proposals.owner_choice: extend _LOWER_WORD's negative lookbehind to also refuse a match immediately preceded by a hyphen, matching _COMMAND's own hyphen-continuation treatment for python-pptx. Lane E does not propose exempting every hyphenated compound unconditionally, only one continuing a hyphen-joined name.
proposals.lane_e_position: no standing to choose; evidence recorded for the owner

A distinct install kind ('documented PYTHONPATH source install, corroborated by N examples, independent of build_verified') would be a real, honest SUPPORTED path here, but is new machinery on a single-instance observation and is not proposed this run.
